description: SPV's message list ("Mesaje"): every document ANAF has put in the taxpayer's virtual space and not yet archived, newest first: decisions, summonses (SOMATII), notifications, payment confirmations (PLATA), receipts, and the answers to requests (RASPUNS SOLICITARE, with the request's id). Each has a `key` for download_message, the time SPV posted it (deadlines usually run from there) and the time it will be archived, after which it can no longer be downloaded. `types` counts every type in the whole list.

cif.description: Only documents for this tax id (a CNP or a CUI), for an account that holds several.

limit.description: At most this many items; `more` says how many were left out.

request_id.description: Only the answer to this request (request_document's request_id).

since.description: Posted on or after: a calendar date in Bucharest, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

text.description: Only messages whose details contain this phrase (case and diacritics ignored).

type.description: Only this SPV document type, as list_messages' `types` names it: DECIZIE, SOMATII, NOTIFICARE, RASPUNS SOLICITARE, PLATA, RECIPISA, ... (case and diacritics ignored).

until.description: Posted on or before: a calendar date in Bucharest, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

name: list_messages
title: List messages
